## Changes

### [#202](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/pull/202) Deep links keep every value of a repeated parameter

- A deep link that repeats `credential_types`, as Credentialing Hub depot links do, kept only one value. The wallet asked for the credential manifest with one type, so an issuer that later offered another type, such as a passport for an ID document depot, had nothing to offer. Every value now reaches the request URI.
- A `vendorOriginContext` now arrives as sent. Before, one with base64 padding lost its padding, one containing `?` or `&` was cut short, a space sent as `+` stayed `+`, and an empty value read as `nil`.
- The request URI keeps its own query as the issuer wrote it, and gets the link's other parameters added to it. A `+` in a value is escaped, so a server no longer reads it as a space.

## Backward incompatibilities

- None for links that the Credentialing Hub and the credential agent build. Some hand-written link shapes read differently from 2.10.1: a request URI that repeats `id` ([#203](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/issues/203)), and an empty or bare link parameter ([#204](https://github.com/velocitycareerlabs/WalletIOS/issues/204)).
